description: This file defines Express routes for development and debugging purposes, including endpoints to check MongoDB connection status, seed the database with sample data, and verify data across collections.

methods.name: router.get('/db-status')
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve MongoDB connection status, including connection state, database name, and host.

methods.name: router.get('/seed')
methods.description: Endpoint to seed the database with sample data if collections are empty, including users, samples, tenants, projects, session tracking, and app deployments.

methods.name: router.get('/verify')
methods.description: Endpoint to verify data availability by returning counts and sample documents from all collections.
